title: Trump Challenges AI Guardrails
description:
On the early edition of Balance of Power, Bloomberg Washington Correspondent Kailey Leinz discusses the calls to rein in advanced artificial intelligence models. On today's show, Stonecourt Capital Partner Rick Davis, Bully Pulpit International Managing Partner Adam Hodge and Committee for a Responsible Federal Budget President Maya MacGuineas.
